# Workshop Extensions

Source: [wiki article 1862](../archive/1862.md); edited 2023-04-13.

<a id="wiki-1862-n1"></a>

- Extension points are earned by disabled player slots (4 each) and using only Workshop maps (16).

<a id="wiki-1862-n2"></a>

- Extensions unlock effects/sounds/projectile types; some ignore Radius, coerce non-team colors to a team color, and first-person effects require player-valued Position.

<a id="wiki-1862-n3"></a>

- Archived costs: Beam Effects2, Beam Sounds1, Buff/Debuff Sounds2, Buff Status2, Debuff Status2, Energy Explosion4, Explosion Sounds2, Kinetic Explosion4, Play More Effects1, Projectiles4, Spawn More Dummy Bots2.

<a id="wiki-1862-n4"></a>

- Play More Effects doubles allowed effects; Spawn More Dummy Bots adds12 bots.

Data: [normalized factual tables](../tables/1862.md).
